My Story

From Passion to Proven Results

I started my journey in local SEO out of a simple frustration: watching genuinely great local businesses get overlooked online while inferior competitors ranked higher simply because they understood search better. That gap felt wrong — and fixable.

Over the past 3+ years, I've dedicated myself entirely to mastering local search. Not as a general digital marketer who does "a bit of SEO," but as a specialist who lives and breathes Google Business Profiles, local pack algorithms, citation consistency, review signals and the dozens of ranking factors that determine whether your business shows up when someone nearby searches for what you offer.

Today, AliPro SEO has helped over 500 local businesses across multiple industries gain the visibility they deserve — turning organic search into their most reliable, cost-effective source of new customers.

🎯

Hyper-Specialized Focus

I work exclusively on local SEO — not social media, not paid ads, not web design. This singular focus means deeper expertise and better outcomes for every client.

📊

Data-Driven, Not Guesswork

Every strategy begins with thorough competitive analysis and keyword research. I build on real data, not gut feelings or outdated tactics that stopped working years ago.

🤝

Personally Invested

I personally lead every project from strategy to execution. Your business gets my full attention — not a junior team working from a template with zero context.

⚡

Results That Actually Matter

Rankings are just the start. I focus on what drives real business growth: more calls, more direction requests, more booked appointments, more revenue.

Mission & Values

What Drives Everything I Do

My mission is simple: level the playing field for local businesses. I believe every quality local business deserves to be found by the customers actively searching for them — regardless of how big their marketing budget is.

I operate with complete transparency. You'll always know what I'm doing, why I'm doing it, and what results it's producing. No black-box tactics, no vanity metrics, no lock-in contracts. Just honest, measurable SEO work that compounds over time.

🔍

Transparency

Clear reporting, honest communication and no hidden tactics. You always see exactly where you stand.

🎯

Results First

Rankings mean nothing if they don't bring paying customers. Every strategy is built around real business outcomes.

⚡

Constant Growth

Google's algorithm evolves. I invest in continuous learning so my clients always have an edge over competitors.

🤝

Partnership

I treat every client's business as if it were my own. Your success is the only measure of mine.

My Expertise

Local SEO Skills That
Move the Needle

🗺️

Google Business Profile Mastery

From initial setup and category optimization to post strategies and Q&A management — I know every lever that influences your Maps ranking and conversion rate.

📍

Local Pack Domination

Deep expertise in the signals that determine local 3-Pack rankings: proximity, relevance, prominence, review velocity and behavioral engagement metrics.

🔗

Citation & NAP Consistency

Systematic citation building across high-authority directories, ensuring perfect NAP consistency that builds the trust signals Google's local algorithm rewards.

✍️

Local Content Strategy

Hyper-local content creation — from location landing pages to neighborhood-specific blog posts — that captures long-tail local searches your competitors overlook.

⭐

Review Generation Systems

Building systematic, ethical review acquisition campaigns that rapidly grow your star rating and review count — two of the most powerful local ranking signals.

⚙️

Technical Local SEO

LocalBusiness schema markup, mobile-first optimization, Core Web Vitals and site architecture improvements that give your local pages a technical edge.

How I Work

My Proven 4-Step SEO Process

A clear, repeatable process that consistently delivers measurable local ranking improvements within 90 – 120 days.

01

Deep Discovery Audit

A comprehensive 150-point audit of your GBP, website, citations, reviews, competitors and local keyword landscape — identifying every gap and opportunity.

02

Custom Strategy Build

A tailored local SEO roadmap built specifically for your business, market and goals — with clear timelines, milestones and measurable KPIs defined upfront.

03

Hands-On Execution

I personally execute the strategy alongside my specialist team — GBP optimization, content, citations, link building and technical fixes — all done to the highest standard.

04

Report, Refine & Scale

Weekly progress updates and monthly strategy reviews. As rankings improve, we identify new opportunities and scale what's working for continued growth.

Meet the Founder

The Person Behind AliPro SEO

Ali Ahmed · Local SEO Specialist & Founder

I started AliPro SEO because I saw too many great local businesses struggling to get found online — not because they lacked quality, but because they lacked visibility. I knew I could fix that.

What sets my approach apart is personal accountability. I don't hand your campaign to a junior executive or run it through a cookie-cutter automation tool. I personally lead the strategy, make the key decisions, and stay close to every campaign's performance week by week.

To ensure we deliver consistent, high-quality results at scale, I work alongside a dedicated team of 5 Local SEO professionals — each a specialist in their own domain. Together, we're small enough to give every client genuine personal attention, and skilled enough to execute campaigns that compete with much larger agencies.
